results.description: Generate a new adjustment request ID after a rejected attempt, turning an operator retry into a new inventory intent.
results.contract: A failed or ambiguous inventory adjustment retains its UUID so retrying the unchanged form is idempotent; only success or a new selected-product intent rotates it.
